One switch for a slower PC. Lighter keeps every feature and trims the background work: fewer NPC cars and car spawns, new travelling crews stop at 24 living NPCs, at most 6 outposts with a roll every 40 minutes or more, less ambient chatter, phones at Low and a performance level of at least Medium. Performance goes further: fewer cars still, crews stop at 16 NPCs, 4 outposts, a roll every 60 minutes or more, one chatter at a time and a performance level of at least Low, which also wins over a pinned level. It only lowers your values, never raises them, and never writes your saved options: back on Off everything reads as you set it. Works in a running game
Default Off (1)

How often ambient NPC cars appear: road traffic, travelers, map cars and car encounters. Works on top of NPC car frequency. 100 keeps the normal rate, 50 halves it, 0 stops them

Upper limit for NPC cars that drive the roads far from every player, without crews loaded. The rate settings scale the count, this caps it. 0 means none
Default 30.

11:
Upper limit for ambient NPC cars with crews near the players at once. The rate settings scale the count, this caps it. 0 means none. Raids and police calls are not counted
Default 12.

13:
A zombie notices an NPC that is moving or has just fired within this many tiles even when it cannot see the NPC (fair targeting). Lower values mean fewer zombies turn to NPCs out of sight
Default 10
14: Far zombies rechecking gunfire per beat
Uzak zombilerin silah sesini yeniden kontrol etmesi
15:
While NPC gunfire is live, far zombies outside its reach recheck it every 0.4 s. This caps how many of them do that per 0.4 s; the rest recheck once a second. Zombies within 10 tiles of the reach are never held, and a new or louder shot rechecks the held ones on time. 0 means no cap
Default 8
Uzak zombilerin silah sesini yeniden kontrol etmesi
16:
Allows all A-Life helicopters: raid and backup arrivals, night searchlights and flyovers. Off: none of these helicopters fly. How often they come is set by Helicopter frequency on the START HERE page.
Default on.
A-Life helikopterleri ve üstten geçiş sıklığı
17:
Average time between helicopters that fly past or circle near a player, at random. Not during the first hours of a character. Helicopter frequency on the START HERE page scales this time: Low doubles it, High halves it. 0 turns flybys off.
Default 36.
